entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Rishiraj Trivedi - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Apoorv Joshi Ga for the State.

Order 
This first application has been filed by the applicant under Section 482 of Bharitya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant, who is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No. 08/2024 registered at Police Station- Kasrawad, District - Khargone (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 406 and 120-B of IPC.
Learned Counsel for the applicant requests not to pursue this application and proposes to surrender before the trial Court.

However, he further requests for a direction to the Investigation Officer/Trial Court to comply with the directions of the Supreme Court in cases of Arnesh Kumar Vs. State of Bihar (2014) 8 SCC 273, Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of investigation (2022) 10 SCC 51.
